About The Firm:

Houlihan Capital is an employee-owned leading, solutions-driven valuation, financial advisory and boutique investment banking firm committed to delivering superior client value and thought leadership in an ever-changing landscape.

Houlihan Capital has extensive valuation experience providing companies with objective, independent, and defensible valuation opinions that meet accounting, regulatory, and corporate governance requirements. Our analyses and reports are transparent, supportable, and clearly outline the assumptions and projections incorporated into our financial models. We consistently apply sound valuation methodologies and unbiased perspective in our work product that enables management teams and fiduciaries to make confident, informed decisions.

Valuation & Financial Advisory Associate - Job Description

Role Overview:

As an Associate in Houlihan Capital’s Valuation and Financial Advisory practice, you will be an integral part of a high-performing team focused on delivering high-quality financial analyses and reports for a diverse range of client valuation needs, including Fair Value Measurement, Financial Reporting, Fair Market Value, Tax Reporting, and Transaction Opinions.

The position provides a unique opportunity to utilize valuation techniques across all types of illiquid investments (including debt, preferred equity, common equity, options, crypto assets, structured products, and more) across a wide variety of industries for private equity funds, venture capital funds, corporations, and many other clients.

Responsibilities:

  • Populate Excel-based valuation models used to value equity, debt, and other illiquid securities for financial reporting, tax, and transaction-related purposes.
    • Review, understand, and synthesize client-provided materials such as financial data, operating agreements, transaction documents, company presentations, and other essential documents.
    • Assist in drafting client presentations and reports, preparing supporting tables, charts, and exhibits that communicate findings.
    • Produce high-quality financial analyses including operating model builds, pro forma capitalization structures, and sensitivity analyses
    • Conduct research on industry trends, market conditions, and company-specific issues that will help client analyses.
    • Work closely with internal team members and clients on multiple engagements to ensure alignment on objectives.
    • Update the project manager on progress toward completion, client-provided information gaps, analytical challenges, and key assumptions.
  • Effectively prioritize tasks across multiple, simultaneous engagements, ensuring tight deadlines are consistently met without compromising quality.
  • Adapt to shifting priorities and manage competing demands by maintaining organized workflows, anticipating bottlenecks, and proactively communicating progress with team members and clients.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree required. Preferred majors include Finance, Accounting, and Economics.
    • MBA preferred; CFA, or other relevant professional designation viewed favorably.
    • 1-2 years of relevant work experience in performing valuations for financial reporting or tax purposes.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex financial concepts in a clear and engaging way.
    • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint is required. Experience with financial databases like S&P Capital IQ, Pitchbook, or Bloomberg is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize tasks, manage simultaneous engagements, and work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • A keen eye for detail, particularly in reviewing financial and legal documents.

Job Description:

Baker Tilly is seeking a Valuation Manager to join our growing Valuation practice. This role will lead and manage valuation consulting engagements, oversee financial and valuation analyses, and deliver high-quality advisory services to clients. The Valuation Manager will also play an important role in developing team members, strengthening client relationships, supporting business development, and contributing to the continued growth and strategic direction of the practice.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage multiple valuation consulting engagements from planning through completion, ensuring high-quality deliverables, timely execution, and exceptional client service.
  • Perform and oversee financial statement analysis, valuation analyses, industry and economic research, and the preparation and review of valuation reports.
  • Conduct management interviews and site visits to develop a comprehensive understanding of clients' businesses, operations, financial performance, and key value drivers.
  • Apply financial analysis, valuation methodologies, accounting principles, operational data, performance measures, and industry benchmarks to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and key business insights.
  • Effectively define engagement scope and objectives, manage project resources and timelines, anticipate and resolve issues, and deliver on client commitments while achieving budget and realization goals.
  • Ensure engagements are performed in accordance with applicable professional standards and legal, regulatory, and firm requirements.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by applying technical valuation expertise, sound business judgment, and strategic insight to complex financial and business matters.
  • Provide leadership, coaching, and mentorship to team members, including reviewing work, providing actionable feedback, and supporting professional development.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve processes, increase operational efficiency, enhance engagement execution, and strengthen the client experience.
  • Support the strategic growth and development of the Valuation practice by identifying market opportunities and contributing to practice initiatives.
  • Contribute to business development efforts, including proposals, presentations, marketing materials, thought leadership, and digital campaigns.
  • Build and maintain strong client and professional relationships through networking, industry events, presentations, conferences, webinars, and other market-facing activities.
  • Collaborate with professionals across offices, service lines, and industry groups to expand capabilities, identify cross-functional opportunities, and support firm-wide growth initiatives.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, business, or a related field required; MBA or other relevant advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years of valuation or related financial advisory experience, with demonstrated experience performing valuations for financial reporting purposes.
  • Strong understanding of fair value measurement principles and U.S. GAAP financial reporting requirements, including experience with ASC 820 and related valuation guidance.
  • Experience with purchase price allocations, business enterprise valuations, intangible asset valuations, goodwill and long-lived asset impairment testing, and other financial reporting valuation engagements strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of commonly accepted valuation methodologies, including income, market, and cost approaches.
  • Strong financial modeling skills and demonstrated experience analyzing historical and projected financial statements, management forecasts, market data, and valuation assumptions.
  • CFA, ASA, CVA or ABV designation preferred
  • Experience managing multiple engagements and leading professional teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience contributing to thought leadership activities such as industry presentations, networking events, webinars, or professional forums preferred.
  • Experience supporting mid-market clients preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly explain technical valuation concepts to clients, auditors, and other stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership, project management, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and proficiency with Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

The pay rate range for this job position is $110,000 - $155,000. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to applicant’s skills, prior experience, qualifications, degrees, professional certifications, work arrangements and geographic location. Baker Tilly offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package to eligible employees.

About Apogem Capital

Apogem is a leading private markets solutions provider with decades of experience focused on the middle market. With approximately $44 billion in assets under management as of December 31, 2025, Apogem partners with institutional investors to deliver disciplined underwriting, strategic capital deployment and long-term value creation.

Apogem Capital operates within the New York Life Investment Management platform of companies, supported by the financial strength and long-term stability of a Fortune 100 mutual organization.

With offices in New York, Chicago and Richmond, Apogem Capital is a leading alternatives investor, with decades of experience investing in the middle market and approximately $41 billion in assets under management. By offering a full range of capital solutions, Apogem delivers innovative solutions to private equity sponsors and portfolio companies while generating access to highly sought-after opportunities for our clients. At Apogem Capital, we pride ourselves on attracting and retaining the best talent by offering a collaborative culture, opportunities for career development and growth, and competitive benefits.

Analyst / Associate Role

Join a high-quality, growing alternative investment management firm as a member of the Valuation Team. This role provides exposure to the valuation of a diverse portfolio of private market investments. The role will also contribute to the continued development of the team’s valuation processes, technology, and analytical capabilities.

This is an opportunity to work closely with senior professionals across the firm and gain a broad understanding of Apogem’s investment strategies and portfolio companies. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to develop meaningful expertise in private market valuations, with a clear path for continued professional growth and advancement within the organization.

Key Areas of Responsibility

  • Valuation Analysis and Governance
    • Perform valuation analyses of private investments across Apogem’s investment strategies.
    • Support the review and validation of third-party valuation marks, including analysis of methodologies, assumptions, and market inputs.
    • Assist with the preparation of quarterly valuation committee materials and supporting analyses.
    • Maintain clear and well-documented support for valuation conclusions.
  • Third Party Valuation Provider Oversight
    • Assist with the oversight of third-party valuation providers, including coordinating data requests, reviewing valuation deliverables, and tracking open items.
    • Review third-party valuations for consistency with established methodologies, policies, and procedures.
    • Identify and escalate valuation issues or discrepancies to senior team members.
  • Valuation Process and Technology Enhancement
    • Leverage technology and data tools to improve the efficiency, consistency, and scalability of the valuation process.
    • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, improve data quality, and streamline reporting.
    • Support the development and implementation of enhancements to valuation processes and procedures.
  • Performance Reporting and Portfolio Monitoring
    • Partner with investment teams to collect, validate, and maintain quarterly portfolio company financial and operating data.
    • Monitor portfolio company performance and identify trends or changes relevant to investment valuations.
    • Prepare recurring and ad hoc portfolio performance reporting for internal stakeholders.
  • Financial Analysis and Modeling
    • Perform financial analysis, valuation modeling, sensitivity analyses, and other ad hoc analyses across the firm’s investment portfolios.
    • Analyze financial and operating information to identify trends, variances, and factors impacting investment valuations.
    • Support senior team members on valuation-related projects and analyses.
  • Collaboration & Professional Development
    • Develop strong working relationships with investment teams, finance, fund accounting, operations, and other internal stakeholders.
    • Develop a strong understanding of Apogem’s investment strategies, portfolio companies, and underlying investment structures.
    • Build foundational expertise in private market valuation methodologies, financial modeling, and relevant accounting and valuation guidance.
    • Stay informed on market developments and trends relevant to the valuation of private investments.

Candidate Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, or another quantitative or analytical discipline.
  • At least 2–5 years of experience in valuation, portfolio management/support, transaction advisory, or a related role.
  • Experience with Private Credit, Private Equity, or other alternative investment strategies.
  • Experience working with third-party valuation providers and/or external auditors.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial modeling and data analysis.
  • Experience with portfolio monitoring and/or investment management systems, such as iLevel, Chronograph, or similar platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into concise, accurate, and actionable insights.
  • Demonstrated resourcefulness, initiative, and an entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to operate effectively in a dynamic environment.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a highly team-oriented environment.

Analyst / Associate Role

Join a high-quality, growing alternative investment management firm as a member of the Valuation Team. This role provides exposure to the valuation of a diverse portfolio of private market investments. The role will also contribute to the continued development of the team’s valuation processes, technology, and analytical capabilities.

This is an opportunity to work closely with senior professionals across the firm and gain a broad understanding of Apogem’s investment strategies and portfolio companies. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to develop meaningful expertise in private market valuations, with a clear path for continued professional growth and advancement within the organization.

Key Areas of Responsibility

  • Valuation Analysis and Governance
    • Perform valuation analyses of private investments across Apogem’s investment strategies.
    • Support the review and validation of third-party valuation marks, including analysis of methodologies, assumptions, and market inputs.
    • Assist with the preparation of quarterly valuation committee materials and supporting analyses.
    • Maintain clear and well-documented support for valuation conclusions.
  • Third Party Valuation Provider Oversight
    • Assist with the oversight of third-party valuation providers, including coordinating data requests, reviewing valuation deliverables, and tracking open items.
    • Review third-party valuations for consistency with established methodologies, policies, and procedures.
    • Identify and escalate valuation issues or discrepancies to senior team members.
  • Valuation Process and Technology Enhancement
    • Leverage technology and data tools to improve the efficiency, consistency, and scalability of the valuation process.
    • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, improve data quality, and streamline reporting.
    • Support the development and implementation of enhancements to valuation processes and procedures.
  • Performance Reporting and Portfolio Monitoring
    • Partner with investment teams to collect, validate, and maintain quarterly portfolio company financial and operating data.
    • Monitor portfolio company performance and identify trends or changes relevant to investment valuations.
    • Prepare recurring and ad hoc portfolio performance reporting for internal stakeholders.
  • Financial Analysis and Modeling
    • Perform financial analysis, valuation modeling, sensitivity analyses, and other ad hoc analyses across the firm’s investment portfolios.
    • Analyze financial and operating information to identify trends, variances, and factors impacting investment valuations.
    • Support senior team members on valuation-related projects and analyses.
  • Collaboration & Professional Development
    • Develop strong working relationships with investment teams, finance, fund accounting, operations, and other internal stakeholders.
    • Develop a strong understanding of Apogem’s investment strategies, portfolio companies, and underlying investment structures.
    • Build foundational expertise in private market valuation methodologies, financial modeling, and relevant accounting and valuation guidance.
    • Stay informed on market developments and trends relevant to the valuation of private investments.

Candidate Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, or another quantitative or analytical discipline.
  • At least 2–5 years of experience in valuation, portfolio management/support, transaction advisory, or a related role.
  • Experience with Private Credit, Private Equity, or other alternative investment strategies.
  • Experience working with third-party valuation providers and/or external auditors.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial modeling and data analysis.
  • Experience with portfolio monitoring and/or investment management systems, such as iLevel, Chronograph, or similar platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into concise, accurate, and actionable insights.
  • Demonstrated resourcefulness, initiative, and an entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to operate effectively in a dynamic environment.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a highly team-oriented environment.
